info.title: dotnet-apl
info.description: The dotnet tool for the ArchPillar.Extensions.Localization family: extract the source template from a built assembly and add, sync, or convert translation catalogs on demand.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Create a new language catalog for a template or across a scope

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Change a single catalog file's format

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --from
options.description: The catalog file to convert

options.name: --to
options.description: The target format id (arb, xliff, po)

options.name: --output
options.description: The file to write the converted catalog to

commands.name: export
commands.description: Bundle the target catalogs in scope into a zip for a translator

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --project
options.description:
A project (.csproj or its directory);
defaults to the current directory

options.name: --solution
options.description:
A solution (.sln/.slnx or its
directory); defaults to the current
directory

options.name: --recurse
options.description:
Include the transitively referenced
projects of the scope

options.name: --source
options.description:
en         The source language the in-code
defaults are written in (default: en)

options.name: --input
options.description: A catalog directory to read

options.name: --lang
options.description:
Export a single culture to one zip;
omit to export every non-source culture

options.name: --output
options.description:
The zip file (with --lang) or the
directory of per-culture zips

options.name: --format
options.description:
The format the bundled catalogs are
written as (default: xliff)

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract the source template from each in-scope assembly

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import a translator's returned zip, routing catalogs back to their origin

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --input
options.description: The zip file returned by the translator

options.name: --project
options.description:
A project (.csproj or its directory) whose catalog
directory to write into

options.name: --solution
options.description:
A solution (.sln/.slnx or its directory) whose
catalog directory to write into

options.name: --output

commands.name: manifest
commands.description: Write the catalog index the HTTP runtime loader reads

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --project
options.description:
A project (.csproj or its directory);
defaults to the current directory

options.name: --solution
options.description:
A solution (.sln/.slnx or its
directory); defaults to the current
directory

options.name: --recurse
options.description:
Include the transitively referenced
projects of the scope

options.name: --source
options.description:
en         The source language the in-code
defaults are written in (default: en)

options.name: --input
options.description:
A catalog directory to read
apl-catalogs.json in the first catalog

options.name: --output
options.description:
The manifest file to write; defaults to
apl-catalogs.json in the first catalog

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Flatten catalogs into one minified bundle per culture for deployment

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --project
options.description:
A project (.csproj or its directory);
defaults to the current directory

options.name: --solution
options.description:
A solution (.sln/.slnx or its
directory); defaults to the current
directory

options.name: --recurse
options.description:
Include the transitively referenced
projects of the scope

options.name: --source
options.description:
en         The source language the in-code
defaults are written in (default: en)

options.name: --input
options.description: A catalog directory to read

options.name: --output
options.description:
The directory to write the per-culture
bundles to

options.name: --format
options.description: The bundle format (default: arb)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report the extractable strings per assembly, and translation coverage

commands.description: Reconcile language catalogs against a fresh template (--check for a CI gate)
